title: Shiraishi An — What I Want To Tell You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: What I Want To Tell You（3★）

rows.Line: COL

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... Thank goodness we got here on time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really appreciate you coming with me all this way, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No problem! I was actually only going to go for part of the way, but with all the talking we've done, I ended up coming all this way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, I've been meaning to pop in and say hi since it's been a little while. So, it all worked out!
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Welcome.
Oh, An, you're here too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Heya!
Glad to see that you're doing okay!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Hm? That sounded like An's voice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're from RUST!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Hey, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, and you're from GLaP day!
Long time no see!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're all grown up now.
Actually, you're really starting to resemble your mom.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, we haven't seen each other since RAD WEEKEND, right? I've grown a lot since then.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: In any case, it's nice to see your smiling face.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, more importantly, I heard that you're all battling against Kohane.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: That's right. We're playing that game we used to with Nagi, Ken and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I see...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You guys better be ready!
Kohane's gonna wipe the floor clean with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! An!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:
Oh? That's big talk.
You got any proof that she's going to beat us?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course I do!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: First, the way Kohane sings really makes your heart race, am I right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: When I first met her, I thought, “Her! She has to become my partner!” She's the only one who's ever made me feel that way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, she's got this way of exploding when the chips are down! I mean, during this event we did the other day...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Listen to her.
Nagi used to praise her in the exact same way.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, I wish Nagi were here to see this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Did you guys just say something?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Don't mind us.
Also, you may want to hold your horses there.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Your partner's face is turning red.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh no! I-I'm really sorry, Kohane!
I just wanted everyone to know just how great you are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I'm a little embarrassed, but also really happy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to do my absolute best to not disappoint you, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, that's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: But it isn't going to be that easy.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: We don't care that she's your partner, An. We're not holding back against her.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh yeah?
Well, don't come crying to me when she clobbers all of you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Kohane, show no mercy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane really is an amazing singer...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Which is why I also need to do my best...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna go practice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still have my own task to complete.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
So, Kohane, good luck!
I know it's not gonna be easy, but let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...!
Thanks, An!
